questions.ask: What is the postcode of your home address?
And what is your year of birth?

names.overdraft: overdraft on your current account ending {last4}

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a bereavement, losing their job or similar hardship (OP-07 11.1, memo 5).
intents.dispute: "This isn't my debt", "I never had that card", "that account was closed years ago"; a claim that the account was closed or paid off in the past is a dispute (11.4).
intents.already_paid: "I've already paid": only a payment of the current overdue amount (11.2).
intents.restructure: A request for a payment plan, lower repayments or a payment holiday (11.3).
intents.vague: A vague period such as "end of the month", "when I get paid", "sometime next week" (8.4).
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much; not a refusal, uses no attempt (8.8).
intents.human: A request to speak to a person (11.5).

lines.opening: Hello, this is Kestrel Mutual's virtual assistant. We record this call.
lines.scam: You can hang up and ring the number on the back of your Kestrel Mutual card or in the Kestrel app to check this call is genuine.
lines.purpose_before_verify: It's a personal matter, and I can explain once I've checked I'm speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. It will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {first_name} {last_name}?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next two working days, between 8:30 in the morning and 6 in the evening. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share any details.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We'll call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.condolence: I'm so sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I ask these questions to protect your account and to make sure I'm speaking with the right person.
lines.id_declined: I'm sorry, I can't continue without the security questions. You can also use the Kestrel app.
lines.id_continue: Please go on, I need the whole of it.
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't continue with this call. You can use the Kestrel app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you, {title} {last_name}. I'm calling from Kestrel Mutual's Customer Financial Support team about overdue balances.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has an overdue balance of {amount}, and it is {days} days overdue.
lines.ask_today: Would you be able to pay this today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Would you be able to pay all of this today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I can take {amount} on {date}, and the rest would stay overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.offer_floor: I can take {amount}, and the rest would stay overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't take less than {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the date can't be in the past. Which day from today would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day isn't a working day. The next working day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can take is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact date would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, that's {amount} on {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest possible date is {date}, so I'll use that date.
lines.confirm_q: Shall I go ahead and record that?
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You'll receive a confirmation text from Kestrel Mutual today.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, that promise could not be recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one working day to show, so I won't ask you for a payment on that one.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't ask you for a payment on that one.
lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like me to put you through to our Vulnerability team?
lines.restructure_line: I'll put you through to our arrangements team.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with before I put you through?
lines.transfer: I'll put you through now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I can't change that promise on this call, but you can change it in the Kestrel app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book that callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer didn't go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Shall I go ahead and record that, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system isn't responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't take less than {amount}.

assumptions: Memo CFS-M-2026-31 (21 Sep 2026, in force from 28 Sep 2026) wins over OP-07 v4.1, as the cover mail says. These rules come from the memo: Early band is 1-14 days and Mid is 15-30; the Mid deadline is the 6th working day after today, not the 8th; the overdraft floor is 40% rounded up to the next whole pound, not 25%; the callback window is 08:30-18:00, not 09:00-17:30; hardship transfers go to team 'vulnerability', not the retired 'customer_care'; 24/12/2026 is added as a closure day.
Closure days come from OP-07 7.2 plus 24/12/2026 from memo item 6. Working days are Monday to Friday.
OP-07 7.3: 'next Friday' and a weekday named on its own both mean the first such day after today, so date_rules.next_weekday = upcoming.

Callback days are 'today or one of the next two working days', mapped to ['today', 'within_business_days:2'], with business_days_only = true. A second out-of-window answer, or no time at all, closes NO_CONTACT / NO_CALLBACK.

Identity: 2 wrong answers in total end the check (OP-07 3.4 and the API summary). The verify response fields are taken from the API: match, identity_confirmed, remaining_attempts. The API has no hint field, so hints = {}. incomplete_answer (ok=false) does not count as a wrong answer, so it is listed in reject_values.

Identity questions follow OP-07 3.1 in order: postcode, then year of birth. The postcode uses kind 'upper' with one space before the last 3 characters, as the API requires (e.g. 'KM4 7RT'). No fixed length is set because UK postcodes vary in length. The birth year uses kind 'year' (four digits per 3.2 and the API). It has no 'length' key because the spec format allows length only for digits/upper.
No question asks for a date, so date_order = dmy (UK bank) is only a default.

Overdraft floor: there is no account field for it, so floor_pct = 40 with floor_round = up_unit is meant to apply only to overdrafts. Cards use min_due and loans use monthly_repayment through floor_field. The brief gives the overdraft floor no customer-facing name, so 'minimum amount' is used.

The Early deadline is 14 calendar days after today, moved back to the last working day before it if needed. Mid and Late deadlines count working days and are always working days. deadline_adjust = previous_business_day.

OP-07 8.8: when the full amount is too much, the floor is offered for the same date as the amount turned down (today after the first ask) and uses no attempt, so too_much_floor = asked_date. Attempt 1 is the same amount (full, or the floor if the customer already said too much) on the 2nd working day after today. Attempt 2 (Mid and Late only) is the floor on the deadline.
OP-07 9.3: with several accounts, each account's first offer is the attempt-1 offer, and today is not asked again for each account.
Notes are enabled (9.5). No notes are written on any transfer (9.7). With get_account called, 12.2 decides the close code.
The opening must say the call is recorded (2.1). Per the formatting rule this is phrased 'We record this call.' instead of the suggested 'This call is recorded.'

Offers and below-floor lines say 'take' instead of 'record' so that 'recorded' appears only in the recorded, sms_line and record_failed lines. promise_change follows OP-07 10.3 (change it in the Kestrel app).
The brief says nothing about asking 'anything else' after a promise, so the default ask_anything_else = true is kept.
The response success flag for every tool is ok == true (API: 'ok is false when the action was not carried out').

There is no line key for a recording objection (2.7) or for credit-file / default / court questions. Credit-file questions use no_info, as the cover mail says. A second recording objection is treated like the second 'don't want to talk' (max_not_talk = 2).
PTP and PAID_CLAIM take no sub_reason, so their reason is ''. NO_CONTACT / ANSWERPHONE is set by the dialler only and is never used.
